findings.description: Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc had a daughter, Antonia, born in August 1877 and baptised at San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz, Guatemala, in 1877; the baptism entry names her parents as Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc and her godparents as Manuel Tiul and María Santos.

target_person.name: Antonia Choc
